items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee (Cozy Cole) does not speak. The interviewer mentions 'Ted' in the context of other musicians (Ruben, Herb, Teddy) and states 'My brother used to go with her, Ted.' There is no evidence of a direct personal or professional relationship between Cozy Cole and Ted.

ctx.x: No, Ruben passed on in 1975. And the rest of them are living, Ted
